title: sprite.ts: colorEffect, alpha, and visible not encoded for instances/shapes inside symbol timelines
description:
encodeDefineSprite() in packages/swf/src/sprite.ts emits plain encodePlaceObject2() for all display objects (shape, text, bitmap, instance) regardless of colorEffect, alpha, visible=false, or blendMode properties. For example, a SymbolInstance inside a library symbol that has colorEffect.type='alpha' will render at full opacity in the SWF.

compile.ts handles all of these for scene timelines: colorEffectToCXForm() → encodePlaceObject2WithCXForm(); visible=false → zero-alpha CXForm; blendMode → encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode(); filters → encodePlaceObject3WithFilters().

Fix: mirror compile.ts's PlaceObject2/3 selection logic in sprite.ts's placement pass. At minimum: (1) pass colorEffect/alpha → CXForm for instances, shapes, and text; (2) encode visible=false as zero-alpha CXForm; (3) pass filters → PlaceObject3. The compile.ts code at around lines 1997–2116 is the reference implementation.
